body.statement: If \(D(0)=D(1)\) almost surely, then every \(\nu_x\in\mathcal N_x\) satisfies \(\nu_x(D(0)>t,R(1)\le r)=\mu_{1x}(D(1)>t,R(1)\le r)\), so \(\Theta_I(P)\) is a singleton equal to the ordinary standardized difference of within-arm cumulative incidences among the common survivor cohort.
body.justification: The reduction checks that the capacity theorem collapses to the familiar identified survivor contrast when treatment has no terminal effect.
body.gap: This is a required sanity reduction rather than a novelty claim.
body.consumer: It supplies a diagnostic implementation test and interpretable benchmark for applied users.
